{{Top|leg}}
'''Rycer''' was an ace [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who fought in the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[F-T6 Rycer]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] was later named in the pilot's honor.
